label: Text 1
transcript: The class read the full text of three Westminster Prime Minister's Questions (PMQs) sessions from different administrations. The shared question: how does each speaker control the agenda of the exchange when given six minutes? The class noticed that agenda-control is rarely about the topic; it is about which question gets answered with which answer.
